plugins.name: assay
plugins.description: Set up end-to-end testing, a pull request quality gate and LLM benchmarks for your product in one prompt: Claude studies the product, writes journeys that check what it actually saved, proves them, adds CI. Plus an agentic freedom test that explores the product and keeps what it finds as regression journeys.
